input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including ticket. The platform provides capabilities for queue. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to create and manage ticket records, so that I can track and organize ticket data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to interact with hello functionality, so that I can accomplish my hello-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to use queue capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
